verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a state business-filing service could plausibly offer a programmatic filing and search API, but the evidence documents no API at all. Filings, searches and orders are described only through the bizfile web portal, mail or in person. Bulk data files are an adjacent offering, not API parity. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the bizfile portal sits behind bot management, with Statement of Information filing moving behind web User Access accounts.
